生产连接请标记为 PROD：打开时二次确认，并受变更窗口约束；未标记时按名称关键: Tag production connections as PROD: opening them asks for confirmation and writes are subject to change windows. Untagged connections are classified by name keywords.
变更窗口外，SQL 客户端中的写操作（DML / DDL / 脚本 / 导入 /: Outside the change window, write operations in the SQL client (DML / DDL / scripts / imports / copy to target) are blocked with a prompt to submit a SQL work order. Queries are not affected.
连接专属窗口（启用时）优先于环境窗口；没有任何窗口的连接不受限制。工单执行同样受: An enabled connection-specific window takes precedence over the environment window; connections without any window are unrestricted. Work order execution also respects the window; approvers with the "Execute work order outside change window" permission can force execution with a reason, which is audited.
封网优先于开放时段，封网期间一律禁止直接执行写操作。: Freezes take precedence over open ranges; direct writes are always blocked during a freeze.
开始=结束表示当天全天；结束早于开始表示跨夜（如 22:00~06:00 从所选: Start = end means the whole day; end earlier than start means overnight (e.g. 22:00~06:00 runs from 22:00 on the selected day to 06:00 the next day). With no ranges the window is open all day, subject only to freezes.
未标记环境的连接若名称含「生产/prod/正式/production」，按 PR: Untagged connections whose name contains "生产/prod/正式/production" are treated as PROD
连接专属窗口启用时覆盖其环境窗口；停用后回退到环境窗口: When enabled, a connection window overrides its environment window; when disabled, the environment window applies

检查是否漏写了 JOIN 条件；确实需要交叉关联时先尽量缩小两侧数据量。: Check whether a JOIN condition is missing; if a cross join is really needed, reduce the rows on both sides first.
改写为 JOIN / EXISTS（半连接），或为子查询中引用外层的关联列建立索: Rewrite it as JOIN / EXISTS (semi-join), or index the correlated columns the subquery references from the outer query.
为 ORDER BY 列建立与排序方向一致的索引，或减少参与排序的行数；必要时调: Create an index on the ORDER BY columns matching the sort direction, or reduce the rows being sorted; increase sort memory (work_mem / sort_buffer_size) if necessary.
为 ORDER BY / GROUP BY 列建立与排序方向一致的索引，让数据按: Create an index on the ORDER BY / GROUP BY columns matching the sort direction so rows are read in index order, or reduce the rows to sort.
过滤条件没能利用索引：为过滤列建立索引（PostgreSQL 可考虑部分索引 /: The filter could not use an index: index the filtered columns (on PostgreSQL consider partial / expression indexes).
全索引扫描仍会读取整棵索引，检查过滤条件是否缺少能用于定位的索引前导列。: A full index scan still reads the whole index; check whether the filter lacks a usable leading index column.
确认是否需要读取整张表；如只需部分数据，增加过滤条件并为其建立索引，或通过 LI: Confirm the whole table really needs to be read; if only part of the data is needed, add a filter and index it, or narrow the range with LIMIT / partition pruning.
为被驱动表的关联列建立索引，让关联走索引查找。: Index the join columns of the driven (inner) table so the join uses index lookups.
为 WHERE / JOIN 中的过滤列建立索引（多列条件考虑联合索引，区分度高: Index the filtered columns in WHERE / JOIN (use a composite index for multi-column conditions with the most selective column first), and make sure no function or implicit type conversion on the column disables the index.
为内层（被驱动表）的关联列建立索引；让结果集小的一侧做驱动表，或让优化器选择 H: Index the join columns of the inner (driven) table; let the smaller side drive the join, or let the optimizer choose a hash join.
统计信息可能过期：执行 ANALYZE TABLE / ANALYZE / 收集: Statistics may be stale: run ANALYZE TABLE / ANALYZE / gather statistics and check the plan again; for heavily skewed data consider histograms or extended statistics.
GROUP BY / DISTINCT / UNION 会产生临时表：可为分组列: GROUP BY / DISTINCT / UNION creates a temporary table: index the grouping columns, use UNION ALL instead of UNION (when deduplication is not needed), or reduce the grouping columns.
